title: Three Weeks and One Short Post
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与社会·灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与社会·灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：gap　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gap 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the engineer ① closed a gap that no inspector on the site would have described, and he said the closing was the whole of the morning. The ② gap, meaning the hole itself and not the gate, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a gap, he said, is the only thing on a site that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ gap in that fence had the same short post beside it, and the ④ gap at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A gap, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the engineer said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the gap was the whole of the matter, meaning the distance and not the hole. The ⑥ gap, meaning the distance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; gap, he said, is either something you close or the only word that means both a hole and a distance. He said the distance is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ gap had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short post. The ⑧ gap of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in November, was one fence and three weeks of describing; gap, he said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ gap I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1981 and is still described as the quietest in the fence. A ⑩ gap, my mother said in 1983, is the only one that improves by being described; every gap, she said, is a distance that has agreed to look like a hole. She said the distance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 缺口；缝隙（指围栏上每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 缺口；缝隙（指那一处本身，与门相对）
C. 固定搭配：close a gap 补上一处缺口
D. n. 缺口（指留给孩子们通过的那处）
E. n. 缺口（抽象总称，指一段围栏的缺口之事）
F. n. 缺口（指平面图里标出、被记录过的那处）
G. n. 分歧；隔阂（generation gap，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 隔阂（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: closed a gap that no inspector on the site would have described
The gap, meaning the hole itself and not the gate
the gap at the far end
the gap was the whole of the matter
the gap had become a line in a plan
The gap of the whole thing
A gap, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: close a gap 意为“补上一处缺口”，1974 年那位工程师补上了工地上没有一位检查员肯描述的缺口。
gap 意为“缺口、缝隙”，指那一处本身而不是大门，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记录。
gap 意为“缺口、缝隙”，指围栏上每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一根矮矮的柱子。
gap 意为“缺口”，指最远端留给孩子们通过的那处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
gap 意为“分歧、隔阂”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份隔阂就是那件事的全部。
gap 意为“隔阂”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处缺口，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
gap 意为“缺口”，指平面图里标出、被记录过的那处，到 1979 年这一处成了计划里的一行。
gap 意为“缺口”，工程师十一月写道，整件事的缺口之事是一段围栏和三个星期的描述。
gap 意为“缺口”，我记得的是计划里描述过的那处，1981 年补上了，至今仍被说成围栏上最安静的一处。
gap 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，一处缺口是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
